description: This Rust source file defines JavaScript (JS) action representations and their conversion to internal browser actions, along with handling of runtime functions, module exports, and snapshot updates within the 'bombadil' project. It includes enums, structs, and methods for processing JS values, especially related to browser automation and logical formulas.

classes.name: RuntimeFunction
classes.description: Represents a runtime function with its JS object and pretty string.

classes.name: BombadilExports
classes.description: Holds references to various JS exports from the 'bombadil' module, including formulas, logical operators, runtime, and time objects.

classes.name: Extractors
classes.description: Manages a collection of JSObject instances and updates them based on snapshots and system time.

methods.name: to_browser_action
methods.description: Converts a JsAction enum variant into a BrowserAction, validating delay and code ranges.

methods.name: from_value
methods.description: Creates a RuntimeFunction from a JsValue, interpreting it as various logical or pure functions.

methods.name: from_module
methods.description: Constructs a BombadilExports instance from a JS module, extracting specific exported objects.

methods.name: from_object
methods.description: Creates a BombadilExports instance from a JsObject, extracting specific properties.

methods.name: module_exports
methods.description: Retrieves all exported properties from a JS module as a HashMap.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes an Extractors instance with an empty list and a reference to the time object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Adds a JsObject to the collection of instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a JsObject at a specified index.

methods.name: update_from_snapshots
methods.description: Updates all registered JSObject instances with new snapshot data and current system time.
